root_idea.summary: The root centers on furnishing a thing with its qualities, making its attributes available for recognition or statement.
root_idea.development: This core yields الوصف for describing or attributing qualities, الصفة for a quality or attribute, and اتصف for being characterized by a quality. The lexical family also preserves specialized usages for attaining fitness for service and, in an intransitive camel construction, traveling well.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form وَصَفَ.
Displayed as the distinct Quran-attested verbal noun وَصْف.

senses.definition: To describe or characterize something by stating its qualities or attributes.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal account of what a thing is like; the description may be true or false.

senses.definition: To attribute or ascribe a quality, characterization, or claim to someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: Used when a description is assigned to an entity, including polemical claims about God or other beings; the attributed claim may be false.

senses.definition: Description or attribution: the stated qualities, characterization, or claim assigned to something.
senses.usage_conditions: A verbal noun for describing or ascribing; in the Quranic occurrence it refers to an attribution or claim.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain the proper age for service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become of full stature and fit for service.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded of a boy and, in the corresponding feminine usage, of a girl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become characterized by a quality; to characterize oneself by it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically construed with بِ; it is also said of a thing that, in an observer’s view, admits or appears capable of description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quality, attribute, property, or description; collectively, the qualities or state of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can denote the condition or case of a thing as well as its descriptive or defining attributes.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In grammatical terminology, an attributive word or epithet (نَعْتٌ).
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The category includes a word denoting an attribute together with a substantive, including active and passive participles, the صفة مشبهة, and the elative. It also includes simple and substantive-dominant epithets; older usage extends the term to an adverbial noun of place or time and to a preposition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to travel well or make good progress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the intransitive expression وَصَفَ البَعِيرُ وُصُوفًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A male servant; a female servant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: وَصِيفٌ denotes the male servant and وَصِيفَةٌ the female servant.

cautions: The Quranic verb group is attested only in active imperfect forms, but its public headword is normalized to the perfect citation form وَصَفَ.
The Quranic nominal occurrence is the inflected form وَصْفَهُمْ and is presented under the citation form وَصْفٌ.
